product_description: Meet your skin's new main character! Say goodbye to heavy, sticky creams that ruin your vibe. Our Watermelon Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ is here to make daily sun defense super juicy and fun. Packed with fresh watermelon goodness, this ultra-light formula absorbs instantly with zero white cast and a non-oily finish that feels like nothing at all. Whether you are running to college or catching the metro, it layers like a dream under your makeup without any pilling or eye sting. Get reliable, skin-smart tan protection that stays fresh all day long, all for just ₹387. Your oily skin will thank you!
